programs.title: Insecure
programs.desc: Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a twenty-something African American woman, lives in Los Angeles.Although she experiences many humiliations, she tries to fight against her chronic lack of self-confidence and her own weaknesses.The lack of money and work problems don't help her at all.Her best friend is Molly (Yvonne Orji), a self-centered lawyer.The series tells the story of the lives of contemporary black women living in the United States.Its originator and producer is the main actress, Issa Rae (First).The artist gained popularity thanks to the website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel - so far she has collected over 200,000 likes.followers and 20 million plays.Yvonne Orji (Love That Girl!), Jay Ellis (The Rules of the Game) and Lisa Joyce (It's Never Too Late) will also appear on screen.Critics compare the series to the cult HBO production titled "Girls".

programs.title: The Last of Us
programs.desc: Twenty years have passed since the destruction of civilization.Joel Miller (Pedro Pascal) is a battle-hardened survivor.One day, a man is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie (Bella Ramsey) out of the oppressive quarantine zone.What begins as a simple assignment soon becomes a dangerous and heartbreaking journey across the old United States.During this expedition, they both begin to understand that they can only rely on each other to survive.Based on the popular video game of the same title.

programs.title: True Blood
programs.desc: The action of the HBO series takes place in the near future.Japanese scientists managed to produce artificial blood.Vampires therefore demand social acceptance.The main character is the waitress Sookie Stackhouse (Anna Paquin), who can read minds.She is fascinated by vampires.One day, a handsome vampire, Bill (Stephen Moyer), appears at the bar and the woman falls in love with her.She decides to live with him, and then trouble begins... The production, awarded with a Golden Globe, was based on the book series "Southern Vampire" by Charlaine Harris.

programs.title: Sinners
programs.desc: The year is 1932. Twin brothers Smoke and Stack (double role of Michael B. Jordan), who have a difficult past, return from Chicago to their hometown in Mississippi.They try to escape from problems and a life of crime.They establish a music club for black people and hope for a new beginning.Their enemy, however, are dark, sinister forces that they must face.At stake is not only the lives of the brothers and their loved ones, but also their culture, history and memory.A dark cinema combining elements of action, horror and a musical drawing on the blues tradition.It is a story about an attempt at redemption and the fight against an invisible evil that symbolizes the weight of the past and past sins.

programs.title: Everest
programs.desc: The year 1996. Rob Hall (Jason Clarke) organizes a commercial expedition to the highest mountain in the world.His brigade includes, among others:Texan Beck Weathers (Josh Brolin) and reporter Jon Krakauer (Michael Kelly).The mountaineers reach the base camp.Over the course of several weeks, they get used to extreme weather conditions and pressure that disregulates the body.Apart from them, other teams are heading to the summit.Hall makes a strategic decision to join Scott Fischer (Jake Gyllenhaal), the head of the Mountain Madness expedition.At the beginning of May, climbers leave the base camp.They struggle with snow storms, bitter cold and lack of oxygen.Extreme conditions put them at the edge of their mental and physical endurance.
